# Claude Code Ultimate Guide

> Community documentation for Claude Code, Anthropic's tool for AI-assisted development. This landing index points to the guide, practical examples and dated machine-readable evidence.

## Snapshot metadata

- Guide version: 3.43.0 (VERSION)
- Landing export synchronized: October 5, 2026
- Scope: versioned guide fede45e34246e01d45995c2c5956e746b5e72839 and landing bfd7371d4737eb2d1e9224ec8ea3c1811e11b925; synchronization is not a deployment date
- Main guide lines: 26185 (guide/ultimate-guide.md; not the total documentation corpus)
- Indexed example entries: 277 across 21 categories (landing examples catalog)
- Landing quiz questions: 473 (Markdown question collection)
- Whitepapers: 13 titles, French and English (landing whitepaper catalog)
- Security database: 184 CVE records, updated 2026-10-04 (AgentSec public feed)
- License: guide CC BY-SA 4.0; templates CC0 1.0

## What the guide covers

1. Quick start: installation, first task, CLAUDE.md setup, learning path and companion project.
2. Core concepts: context management, Plan Mode, permissions, model selection and memory.
3. Skills and commands: frontmatter, ownership, discovery, evals, distribution and lifecycle.
4. Agents and hooks: delegation, agent teams, event automation and permission controls.
5. MCP integration: server setup, tool design, MCP versus CLI trade-offs and the guide MCP product.
6. Harness engineering: model/runtime/repository/orchestrator responsibilities, loops, graphs, verification and recovery.
7. Security: sandboxing, supply chain threats, privacy, hardening and reviewed incident evidence.
8. Workflows: CI/CD, code review, bounded Best-of-N selection and open source contribution evidence.
9. Ops and adoption: AI FinOps, observability, team metrics, roles and knowledge infrastructure.
10. Lean and AI: review capacity, work in progress, queue measurements and recurring defect controls. The guide claims no measured software-team gain from the analogy.
11. Reference: cheatsheet, glossary, examples, release tracking and translation status.
